Generating Map Screen

When clicking Map from the upload screen, i am taken to a loading screen, I must then click Continue to get to my map.

This page exists because we need the criteria structure to load in the background.

Changes: Instead of having a user driven interaction (pressing the Continue button) we have a loading screen that changes automatically when the report is ready to be accessed.

Note: We also want to remove the back button in the app so users are unable to go back during this process.
